measure_name: Completed sampled changes with explicit acceptance-evidence references
numerator_definition: Count of sampled completed changes with at least one resolvable acceptance-evidence reference
denominator_definition: All sampled completed changes in the measurement window
evidence_source: Change handoff packets and acceptance records
interpretation_limit: Shows whether evidence linkage is being used; it does not establish that the evidence is sufficient or that releases have better outcomes

measure_name: Completed sampled changes requiring corrective rework within fourteen days
numerator_definition: Count of sampled completed changes with unplanned corrective rework within fourteen days of release
denominator_definition: All sampled completed changes with a full fourteen-day observation window
interpretation_limit: Directional quality signal only; rework can be caused by factors outside acceptance-evidence practice

measure_name: Sampled security events with owner and disposition recorded
numerator_definition: Count of sampled security events with both a review owner and documented disposition
denominator_definition: All sampled security events selected by the stated sampling rule
interpretation_limit: Shows process adoption; documentation alone does not prove the disposition was timely or effective

measure_name: Reviewed events matching an unresolved previously identified recurring pattern
numerator_definition: Count of reviewed events matching a previously identified pattern whose treatment decision remains unresolved
denominator_definition: All reviewed events in the measurement window
interpretation_limit: Directional recurrence signal; event mix and detection changes can alter the rate independently of the recommendation

measure_name: Priority incident actions with owner and follow-up trigger
numerator_definition: Count of sampled priority corrective actions with both an owner role and explicit follow-up trigger
denominator_definition: All sampled priority corrective actions from completed incident reviews
interpretation_limit: Shows follow-through mechanics are recorded; it does not prove actions are the right actions or are completed

measure_name: Incidents linked to a previously recorded unresolved contributing condition
numerator_definition: Count of sampled incidents linked to a contributing condition already recorded as unresolved before the incident
denominator_definition: All sampled incidents with completed contributing-condition review
evidence_source: Incident timelines postmortems and action register
interpretation_limit: Directional repeat-condition signal; incident severity mix and review depth can change the observed rate
